acceptanceCriteria: JT-AC-059: present the existing eight version-one systems as immutable predefined catalog records, distinct from user-created systems, with classification, context, ordered pitch data, reference assumptions, available provenance, and limitations.

Search built-in and custom profiles and tuning systems by applicable names, alternate names, instruments, regions, traditions, descriptive metadata, contained pitches, and sounding frequencies; provide deterministic metadata-backed filters and clear empty states. Support VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and localized labels without implying unsupported cultural coverage.
Catalog browse, search, filtering, row selection, detail navigation, and return preserve the selected profile and playback state, remain silent, and do not mutate predefined or user data.
component: iPhone tuning-system catalog discovery, detail, search, and filtering.
componentsAffected: iPhone catalog list and detail surfaces
